# The Crowd Tape

> The Crowd Tape tracks what top US-stock accounts on X say and turns it into a daily view of crowd sentiment. It currently tracks 201 accounts (200 on X and 1 on Truth Social). Available in Traditional Chinese and English.

## What the site shows
- Daily bull/bear consensus: which tickers the tracked accounts are bullish or bearish on
- Daily snapshot of the most-discussed tickers
- Pre-market focus
- Robot stock picks with transparent paper trading
- Per-ticker pages and a summary of each tracked post with a link to the original

## Main pages
- [Home](https://thecrowdtape.com/)
- [中文 (Traditional Chinese)](https://thecrowdtape.com/zh/)
- [English](https://thecrowdtape.com/en/)
- [Support](https://thecrowdtape.com/en/support/)
- [Sitemap](https://thecrowdtape.com/sitemap.xml)

## Stock pages
One page per ticker and language: https://thecrowdtape.com/<lang>/stock/<TICKER>/
Example: https://thecrowdtape.com/en/stock/AAPL/

## More pages
- https://thecrowdtape.com/en/about/ (methodology)
- https://thecrowdtape.com/en/newsletter/ (weekly digest archive)
- https://thecrowdtape.com/en/advertise/
- https://thecrowdtape.com/en/tools/

## Full data snapshot
- https://thecrowdtape.com/llms-full.txt

## Update frequency
The site is rebuilt automatically by GitHub Actions every 4 hours (cron `17 3-23/4 * * *` UTC, i.e. 03:17, 07:17, 11:17, 15:17, 19:17 and 23:17 Hong Kong time).

## Disclaimer
Not investment advice. The content summarises public posts by third parties and is for information only.
